name: Riverwoods Development Grant
summary: Grants of up to £20,000 in Scotland to scope, plan and design river woodland creation and restoration, producing a development plan that comes before field delivery. Charities, community groups and local bodies apply; round two closes on 1 December 2026.

eligibility.rule: Produces a written River Woodland Development Plan for an identified and defined area in Scotland
Project has not started and activities take place during the contracted award period
Total project value is at least £5,000

documents: Latest audited or verified accounts (new organisations: last 3 bank statements or a bank letter)
Letters of support or written confirmation from participating project partners or landowners/managers, if applicable

status.quote: We are currently accepting new applications for the Riverwoods Development Grant.

deadline.quote: The deadline for completed applications is 12 noon on 1 December 2026.

pool.quote: In total, £250,000 is available for Round Two.

applicant_types.quote: Applicants should be based in Scotland and be one of the following: ENGO Charitable Trust/Organisation Constituted Community Group/ Voluntary Group / Foundation Environmentally focussed not for profit organisation Local public bodies including Local Authorities and District Salmon Fisheries Boards

geography.quote: Applicants should be based in Scotland and be one of the following

access.quote: The Application Form must be completed in full (either in Word or PDF format) and submitted

window.quote: a second round of funding has been made available

amount.quote: Applicants can apply for up to £20,000. Funding requests are expected to be within the £10,000-£20,000 range.

co_finance_required.quote: A minimum of 10% funding for the project must come from other sources. In-kind contributions are accepted.

effort.quote: The form must be completed in full and submitted riverwoods@scottishwildlifetrust.org.uk with the subject line "Development Grant Application - [Your Organisation]" by 12 noon on 1 December 2026.

eligibility.quote: All funded projects must include an outcome to produce a written River Woodland Development Plan for an identified and defined area in Scotland.
This Grant cannot fund a project that has already started and funds can only be used to pay for activities taking place during the contracted award period (e.g. February 2027-June 2028).
The minimum total project value is £5,000, however there is no minimum Grant request threshold.

co_finance.quote: A minimum of 10% funding for the project must come from other sources. In-kind contributions are accepted.

after_award.quote: Successful applicants will be required to submit brief progress reports on a quarterly basis throughout their contracted award period.

documents.quote: Please provide a copy of your organisation's constitution and your Charity number (if applicable).

A copy of your organisation's most recently audited or verified accounts. o If you are a new organisation and do not have audited accounts, you can submit your last three bank statements, or a letter from your bank confirming that you have opened an account. • You must complete this online survey to show your project location.

Letters of support or other written confirmation from any participating project partners or landowners/managers, as applicable. • Any additional supporting evidence of the need for your proposed project.
